scope: Sound data that 81:F092 and F130 send to the sound driver: the two directories of 98:FFFA with their mode lists (pairs of mode and item that F1FA loads), their block lists and the data chunks. The table chunks (sample directory, header, sounds, vibrato and note tables, pointer tables) and the songs (pieces: song header, track, tempo list, pattern with event strings) are readable here. Each sample names its WAV in vm-samples/ (16-bit mono, decoded from silence, nominal 32 kHz) and keeps its BRR block headers as hex (blocks) and, for blocks whose PCM does not determine the nibbles, those nibbles (nibbles, by block index). Role is the base list section the chunk lands in (0x04E1), aram its destinations. See src/data/sound.mjs and src/data/brr.mjs.
